events.title: Apotheosis Engine Demo Released!
events.summary: The demo version of 'Apotheosis Engine' has been released. It is now available to download via Steam. The demo includes a recent version of 'Stage 1- Probe', although the experience is subject to change for the final release. Check it out and leave some feedback!The first stage is a pure incremental game; the probe flies, you click and optimise and build. Future stages have much more varied gameplay!

events.title: Apotheosis Engine Announced
events.summary: We are happy to announce 'Apotheosis Engine'; an addictive Idle clicker game. Set in the infinite reaches of an alternate dimension; you play as a simple probe from a long distant civilization; one among millions. Drifting for millennia, the probe evolves, grows and shapes itself. Survival for the probe no longer becomes merely an option; it must grow, become sentient, and then follow the rules of survival; explore expand exploit exterminate. The only way to exterminate is to become a god.wheeee
